description: Get a Toast restaurant's menu: menus → groups → items with name, description, price, per-size prices and out-of-stock flag. `restaurant` is a GUID or any link that contains one (use toast_resolve_restaurant for a bare shortUrl). `source`: "online" (default) is what the restaurant sells through online ordering; "pos" is the register's full menu (often far larger); "both" merges them: an item on both menus is listed from the online menu with `sources` ["online","pos"]. An item filed under several groups ("Popular" plus its own category, say) appears under each, so `total_items` counts listings, not distinct items; dedupe by `guid` for a count. `query` searches item names, descriptions and group names. Prices are in dollars (12.5 = $12.50, checked against the ordering page). Modifier/option prices are not included.

query.description: Only items whose name/description/group contains this (case-insensitive).

restaurant.description: Restaurant GUID, or a Toast link containing one.

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact (default) returns the shaped result; "full" returns the Toast gateway's raw `data` object untouched.

name: toast_get_menu
